source.author: しゑひ(shiwehi)
source.fetch_method: curl through the session proxy, TLS verification ON, with --cacert naming a bundle that adds the Let's Encrypt YE2 intermediate (shiwehi.com omits it from its chain), the method STSD, BT砲 and 階段のドネイト used. The snapshot is the page's raw HTML, byte for byte; every board is plain text in it, 20 ten-wide boards in page order. (The first transcription, 2026-10-23, was checked against a markdown rendering, sha256 b069e04f665c1a5cba7704efaa58957aa4f519785eabeef496afc1d6d33014f8, 8120 bytes, because the host was refused then; every board and every quote is the same against this raw HTML, and the page's creation_date meta is 2021-04-02, not the 2021-04-01 that version recorded.)
source.snapshot_note: sha256 of the raw HTML this transcription was checked against. Not re-verifiable in CI: the page is not committed and cannot be fetched there. Re-check with --html-dir after any refetch (with harddrop's Double_Triple_Cannon_Setups.wikitext beside it); an HTML hash moves with ANY byte of the page (ads, sidebar, a date), so a moved hash means "read the board diff", not "the boards changed". Sentences are compared against the page with its tags dropped.

quotes.verbatim: DT砲の形と消し方
DT砲の形は以下の通りで、その名の通り、TSDを打った後にTSTを打つことができます。
回転方法
switchのキーで解説していきます。
初めに右回転をしてから壁に寄せ、下におろしてから左回転、左回転です。
1つ目の%Tさえ入れることができれば、2つ目は普通のTSTです。
DT砲の作り方
TSD屋根付き1列待ちの形
DT砲の最も作りやすい形は、TSDの形を作って%I待ちをしている時に、代わりに%J%Lを立てて作る方法です。
通常上図のようになるところを、下図のようにすることでDT砲の形を作れます。
穴が2マス以上必要
上図では72積みの形で説明していますが、同様の形があればどこでも構いません。
TSD屋根待ちの形から
TSDの屋根待ちの状態から下図のようにして途中DTを組むことができます。
基本的には%L(左右反転の場合は%S)を使用します。
この方法でDT砲を作った時、TSTを打つ前に%Zの左上のマスを埋める必要がありますが、63積みの3側に低い屋根を付けた場合は、%I以外で埋めようとすると%Tが入らなくなってしまうので注意してください。
TSD完成形から
TSDの形が完成している状態からも、条件によっては途中DTを組むことができます。
屋根が無い側の壁は2マスまで
逆に、屋根がある側の壁は%Jを引っ掛けることができるので、屋根にプラスして4マスまで高くすることができます。
開幕テンプレ後の派生としてのDT砲
開幕テンプレからの派生としてDT砲を組むテンプレもいくつか存在します。
DTDT(開幕DT砲からの派生)
のそみ砲(Mr.T-Spin's STDからの派生)
のそみ砲と呼ばれるDT砲派生が存在します。

variants.window_note: in basic.spin's frame, row 0 the top: the AGREEMENT BOX of this page's eight drawings of the shape and harddrop SDPC Spin's two DT Cannon continuations. Column 0 is the wall; rows 5-6 are the rows the TSD clears (entailed by the clear at a full TSD, NaiveClauseForced); above them the TST slot's nub row (row 4: the stem over the T's middle and the nub toward the wall, walled both sides), the stem's row walled both sides (row 3), the overhang's second cell (row 2) and the overhang over the stem (row 1); under them the stem's bottom cell, walled both sides (row 7). Everything right of column 3, and row 0, is outside: the drawings disagree there. Occupancy only, never colour; garbage is filled.

followup.note: the T stood up into the TST slot, nub toward the wall (the page: 「2つ目は普通のTSTです」). Before the TSD its cells are split by the two cleared rows (three above them, the stem's bottom cell under them, under the TSD's nub); the TSD joins them, and the matcher carries the slot through every later clear to the next T.

cross_source.note: the window, by the gate's predicate (technique_transcription.window_fires), over every U-slot board of every committed *-routes.json, with the U cells as the T: it fires on harddrop SDPC Spin's two DT Cannon continuations, mirrored, and on nothing else. The same two boards are external agreement drawings (`routes_drawings`), beside harddrop's own DT Cannon page (`harddrop`): its drawings whose drawn T the window fires on, and every other board of that page the window fires on or nearly does, recorded.

harddrop.note: every one of the page's 133 boards is in exactly one list or none, measured both ways by harddrop_page_problems: a board in none draws no T, the window fires nowhere on it, and it has no near miss (a terrain without its overhang, a step between two drawings, or another setup altogether). The `drawings` are agreement drawings, and they do not move the window: it is the same box without them (the page's drawings and SDPC Spin's already fix it), so they corroborate it and decide nothing
